title: Un Coup de Dés (le hasard n'est pas aboli)
summary: Broodthaers's black-bar redaction of Mallarmé re-staged as live text the browser cannot truly abolish.
mechanism: Words rendered as opaque bars via color:transparent on their own black inline-boxes, still selectable/copyable/in-source, with browser reflow re-throwing the constellation and a resize counter.
references: Marcel Broodthaers, Un Coup de Dés Jamais N'Abolira Le Hasard (Image) (1969)
Stéphane Mallarmé, Un Coup de Dés Jamais N'Abolira Le Hasard (1897)
